issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new model, mail, migration and two Livewire components.
Public input properties are validated with inline $this->validate([...]) instead of the required #[Validate] plus $this->validate() pattern.
Server-context selectedMembershipId (?int) and confirmingRemoval (bool) are public without #[Locked], violating the Livewire lock rule.
Public confirmRemoval and cancelRemoval mutate UI state without any server-side authorization check.
New table and invite-only business rules are not reflected in docs/database-schema.md or docs/business-rules.md.
PendingInvites authorizes via abort_unless email comparison rather than through a policy or gate.
Email normalization is implemented twice with both a saving hook and a setEmailAttribute mutator doing the same strtolower(trim()).
Model defines isPending and scopePending helpers but both Livewire render methods repeat the same whereNull/where expires query inline.
Route adds can:update,entity middleware to a Livewire route with no evidence of Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for update requests.

conventions.evidence: Follows $fillable attribute (EntityInvite.php:449), reversible down() (migration:594), audit channel (Members.php:143); but uses inline validate without #[Validate] (Members.php:71,196) and updates no docs/ files.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/accept/decline; clear names; no dead code or debug output; consistent Blade/Bulma style.

requirements.evidence: Migration unique entity_id/email with defaults (migration:577); factory 7-day expiry plus expired() (factory:539); sendInvite validation/member/pending/race/rate-limit/mail/audit/reset (Members.php:71); accept idempotent/expired/session/redirect and decline (PendingInvites.php:286); mail markdown emails.entity-invite with login button (EntityInviteMail.php:397, emails/entity-invite.blade.php:1); manager-only mount plus route can:update (Members.php:60, web.php:874); modals with exact header and reset (members.blade.php:792).

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves invites, members modals, mail, langs, switcher/onboarding slots and CHANGELOG; no unrelated refactors or features.

security.evidence: Data-changing actions authorize (Members.php:68,160,169,184; PendingInvites.php:292,331) and scope lookups via entity->invites()/memberships()->findOrFail; validation before writes; {{ }} escaping; but confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval lack authorize and selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval lack #[Locked].

simplicity.evidence: Reuses audit log, PegaFila mail theme, policies and unique constraint for races; lean overall with minor duplication in dual email normalizers and unused scopePending.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ additions; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for sendInvite, cancelInvite, openMember, saveRole, removeMember, accept or decline.

review.summary: The change implements the full invite-only flow, manager-only members page with detail and removal modals, queued invite mail and translations correctly. It is blocked by missing tests, Livewire convention gaps (no #[Validate]/#[Locked], unauthenticated UI-flag actions) and unsynced docs, requiring substantial rework before merge.
